finding_text: Personnel costs charged to CFDA 17.258 lacked contemporaneous time-and-effort documentation for 3 FTEs.
Vendor invoices over micro-purchase threshold missing competitive quotes; duplicate invoice paid twice then reversed.
FFR submitted with expenditure totals that did not reconcile to general ledger by $41,200; prior year finding repeated.
Participant eligibility files incomplete; services billed for period before enrollment date.
Costs charged after award period of performance without approved extension.
Unallowable entertainment and gift cards charged to federal award; questioned costs removed in subsequent claim.
